about: Links a housing or credit law does not show in a played world, with the registered stopgap behind each. world-small-dollar-lenders built the small-dollar lenders the consumer-loan rate cap binds (Oct 29); the cap's outcome-web link stays partial until a checker run shows the lender reading the links' factor past their 12-month lag, which only the lenders test shows today.

web.why: the year-long check cannot show the cap links' 12-month lag: the checker changes the law once and leaves it to the world's legislature, which in the one checker place with a lender put the cap back seven months in, so no checker run shows the lender reading the factor; the runs whose web ledger did move began with the cap, where no lender opens, so nobody read those rows. The played lenders test holds the law past the lag and shows the read; its records are the evidence
